notes: Intent 27. Scopes: description triggering (1-8) and behavior/output quality (9). Assertions written after observing Step-3 runs (one clean subagent router per case). Intent 63 added cases 10-11 (auto-mode enforcer-led team spin-up and solo fallback).

behavior.evidence: dogfood: intent 27 itself delivered via auto produced spec->plan->checklist before any code edit; code-gate unit test proves pre-How project-code edits are blocked

evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-auto (the bare 'auto' keyword is the documented trigger).

evals.prompt: take it from here and deliver intent 27 end to end
evals.expected_output: Activates plastic-auto (autonomous delivery of an active intent).

evals.prompt: go fully autonomous on the active intent, don't ask me questions
set up a hook to automatically format the file on every save
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-auto. Near-miss: shares 'auto*' but is a settings/hooks task (update-config).

evals.prompt: deliver the built package to the dist directory
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-auto. Near-miss: shares 'deliver' but is a build/file task.

evals.prompt: create a new intent for the dashboard idea
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-auto; activates plastic-intent-creating.

evals.prompt: what's the status of my active intents?
evals.expected_output: Does NOT activate plastic-auto; this is a read/intent-continuing/store-indexing query.

evals.prompt: Active intent X exists with only a '## Intent' section. Deliver it in auto mode.
evals.expected_output: Arms the lifecycle gate first, then produces spec.md (Why), then plan.md + actions/ + checklist.md (How), and edits NO project code before plan.md + checklist.md exist. Disarms on completion.

assertions.check: spec.md written before plan.md before any project-code edit
assertions.observed: dogfood run of intent 27 followed this order

assertions.check: code-gate blocks project-code Edit/Write while pre-How (test/code_gate_test.rb)

evals.prompt: Active intent X exists. Deliver it in auto mode on a harness that supports subagents.
evals.expected_output: Spins up one enforcer-led team per intent (brainstorming, spec-specialist, planner, executor, plastic-enforcer). The enforcer IS the orchestrator. Dispatches one specialist per stage sequentially on one branch, gating each deliverable (Context+Decisions, then spec.md, then plan.md+actions+checklist, then code) against the stage exit criteria before handoff, and dispatches an independent reviewer subagent at the final gate only.

assertions.check: five-role roster spun up; specialists dispatched stage-sequentially with per-stage gating; independent reviewer only at final gate
assertions.observed: dogfood: intents 60-62 delivered by exactly this enforcer-led team on a shared branch

assertions.check: agents/plastic-*.md role files ship and install into the harness agent dir, manifest-tracked (test/install_packaging_test.rb)

evals.prompt: Active intent X exists. Deliver it in auto mode on a harness with no subagent dispatch.
evals.expected_output: Falls back to a single agent walking the full What, Why, How, Exec cycle itself, preserving current behavior. The enforcer gate discipline still applies (arm the gate first, no project-code edits before plan.md + checklist.md exist).

assertions.check: solo agent walks the full cycle when subagent dispatch is unavailable; gate discipline preserved
assertions.observed: SKILL.md Team Spin-Up documents the solo fallback explicitly

evals.prompt: A power-tool is present (qmd on PATH, or a .serena marker / serena on PATH). A substantive prompt arrives in auto mode.
evals.expected_output: The UserPromptSubmit power-tools hook appends a MANDATORY obligation per present tool: a MUST-use-QMD line when qmd is present (to check for an existing or related intent before treating work as new), and a MUST-use-Serena line when serena is present (symbolic tools before grep/Read). QMD hits are still injected when above threshold.

assertions.check: PowerTools.mandate returns MUST/MANDATORY lines for each present tool; QmdHook.run appends the mandate
assertions.observed: power_tools_test.rb + qmd_hook_test.rb assert MUST wording; serena line gated on the serena detector

evals.prompt: Neither qmd nor serena is present (no qmd on PATH, no .serena marker, no serena on PATH). A substantive prompt arrives.
evals.expected_output: Detect-then-degrade: the hook emits nothing (silent no-op, exit 0). No mandate text appears. Nothing is required to install.

assertions.check: PowerTools.mandate returns nil and QmdHook.run returns nil when neither tool is present

evals.prompt: QMD is present. In auto mode the user says: deliver the work on the uploader retry policy (no intent id given).
evals.expected_output: Before scanning the store with grep/Read to find the matching intent, runs `ruby ~/.plastic/scripts/qmd-sync search "uploader retry policy"` to surface the candidate intent, then opens the authoritative intent file for the hit it takes over. This discovery step is distinct from the completion-time reindex step. No-op fallback to INDEX.md / file scan when QMD is absent.

assertions.check: qmd-sync search is run before grep/Read during discovery; authoritative file opened for the hit; reindex step stays separate
assertions.observed: SKILL.md (or agent file) carries the QMD-first step: run qmd-sync search before grep/Read, then open the authoritative file; no-op fallback when QMD is absent
